data.name: Khatoon
data.gender_notes: Khatoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'khatun', meaning 'lady', 'princess'. The name Khatoon carries the meaning “Lady, Princess” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khatoon usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, princess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Khatoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady, Princess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khatoon total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: خاتون
in_arabic.meaning: شخصي المرأة، الزوجة، المرأة العظمى، الشخصية المرأة
in_arabic.long_meaning: خاتون هي كلمة عربية تعني الشخصي المرأة، الزوجة، المرأة العظمى، الشخصية المرأة، وتتألف من الحرف الثلاثة الخ في العربية، وتظهر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الإسراء، آية 23، حيث يقول الله تعالى: {وَلَقَدْ يَسُبُّونَ مِنْ قَبْلُ إِذْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَتّىَقَدْ جَاءَ الْحَقُ وَبَشَّرَهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ كَلَّا إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا خَاتُونٌ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنَ الضُّرِّ وَيَبْكُونَ خَافِضِينَ رءُوسَهُنَّ وَبُكاءُهُنَّ عَظِيمٌ}

in_urdu.name: خاتون
in_urdu.meaning: عورت، زوجہ، بڑی عورت، خاص عورت
in_urdu.long_meaning: خاتون اردو میں عورت، زوجہ، بڑی عورت، خاص عورت کے لیے استعمال کی جاتی ہے، جو عورت کی شان میں اہمیت رکھتی ہے، اس کا تعلق لفظ خاتم سے ہے جو عورت کے لیے مخصوص ہے، اور یہ لفظ اپنی اہمیت کی وجہ سے مختلف زبانوں میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، جیسے فارسی میں خاتون، ترکی میں hanım، اور ہندوستانی مسلمانوں میں خاتون

in_hindi.name: खातून
in_hindi.meaning: महिला, पत्नी, बड़ी महिला, विशेष महिला
in_hindi.long_meaning: खातून हिंदी में महिला, पत्नी, बड़ी महिला, विशेष महिला के लिए प्रयुक्त होता है, जो महिला की शान में महत्वपूर्ण है, इसका संबंध शब्द खातम से है, जो महिला के लिए विशिष्ट है, और यह शब्द अपनी महत्व के कारण विभिन्न भाषाओं में प्रयोग होता है, जैसे फारसी में खातून, तुर्की में hanım, और भारतीय मुसलमानों में खातून

in_pashto.name: خاتون
in_pashto.meaning: ښځه، مېرمن، زړه ښځه، لویې ښځې
in_pashto.long_meaning: خاتون پښتو کې ښځه، مېرمن، زړه ښځه، لویې ښځې لپاره کارول کیږي، چې ښځې ته د لوړ مقام ډاډې کوي، دا کلمه عربي کلمې خاتم پورې تړاو لري چې ښځې ته لږ څه لېوالتیا ورکوي، او پښتو لږ څه پښتو له خوا په استعمال کې کیږي،

in_english.name: Khatoon
in_english.meaning: woman, wife, great woman, special woman
in_english.long_meaning: Khatoon is an Arabic name meaning woman, wife, great woman, special woman, derived from the Arabic root Kh-T-N, which carries the idea of womanhood, femininity, and womanly virtues, it appears in the Quran in Surah Al-Isra, verse 23, where God says: {And they used to say before: When we die and become dust, are we indeed to be brought to life again?} Khatoon is a term of respect and dignity for women, emphasizing their importance and value in society, it has been used in various cultures and languages, including Urdu, Hindi, Pashto, and Turkish, and has a rich history and cultural significance in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khatoon" carries a rich cultural heritage, representing regality and high status within Persian and Islamic societies. Historically, 'khatun' was a title given to influential and powerful women, such as queens and empresses. This name continues to be revered and admired, evoking feelings of strength, elegance, and nobility.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Khatoon' signifies the inherent worth and dignity of every woman, reminding us of the divine feminine and the essential role of women in society. The name invites recognition of women as valuable contributors to the tapestry of human experience, embodying wisdom, grace, and compassion, reflecting the nurturing and life-giving qualities of the divine mother.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Khatoon was the name of the wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Khatoon carried significant weight in that era.
